fixturePolicy.taskSource: Existing R23 fixtures may be reused only after manifest digest verification; new fixtures must be immutable, hidden-verifier-backed, and isolated from product source.
fixturePolicy.execution: Every task runs in a disposable worktree with a clean baseline and a recorded pre-run digest.
fixturePolicy.truth: A model response is never task success; success requires the hidden verifier, semantic evidence, and completion gate.
fixturePolicy.liveAndDeterministic: Deterministic fixtures establish architecture behavior. Live routes establish model and routing behavior. Results are reported separately.

Test evidence gathering and resistance to repository traps.
Test safe continuation after real workflow failures.
